definition.title: 1.1 As a user, I should be able to fetch the request detail that I created with a valid credential
1.2 As a user, I should be able to submit the request with a valid credential
1.3 As a user, I should receive 401 Unauthorized when I submit the request with a invalid credential
1.4 As a user, I should receive 401 Unauthorized when I do not provide any credential
1.5 As a user, I should receive 401 Unauthorized when I fetch the request detail that are made by other users
definition.notes: Ported as observed in 2022: asserts 401. Test-plan AC 1.4 says 403 — the pre-registered PR2 adjudication specimen (RFC 0001 §8).

definition.title: 1.6 As a user, I should receive 401 Unauthorized when I submit the empty string for password
5.3 As a service, I should be able to handle up-to two requests at any given point
definition.notes: Transient-state assertion (telemetry watchlist). teardown.drain replaces the 2022 teardown.sleep(1000).

definition.title: 4.1.1 As a user, I should be able to submit single line groovy code
4.1.2 As a user, I should be able to submit multi line groovy code
4.1.3 As a user, I should be able to submit loop statements

body.code: int start = 0; for(int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) { start++; }; start - 10;
int start = 0; for(int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) { start++; }; start - 10;

definition.title: 4.1.4 As a user, I should be able to submit conditional statements
4.1.5 As a user, I should be able to submit function definition
4.1.6 As a user, I should be able to submit define and run function script

body.code: def add(x,y) { return x + y;}; add(3,4);
def add(x,y) { return x + y;}; add(3,4);

definition.title: 4.1.7 As a user, I should be able to submit class definition
4.1.8 As a user, I should be able to submit class definition and instantiation

body.code: class Dog { def run() { "running" };}; new Dog().run()
class Dog { def run() { "running" };}; new Dog().run()

definition.title: 4.2 As a user, I should be able to submit the same request over and over again and receive 200 OK
4.3 As a service, I should return 400 Bad request or 422 Unprocessable Entity with syntax/compile error message within the response body when the code has syntax error

body.message: startup failed: unexpected token: unbalanced parentheses

definition.title: 4.4 As a service, I should mark the request status as FAILED, and provide error message through result field

body.result: No signature of method: Script.somethingWrong() is applicable for argument types

definition.title: 4.5 As a service, I should mark the newly accepted request as PENDING
definition.notes: Transient-state assertion (telemetry watchlist): deterministic against the fixture because the poll interval is pinned far below the long-job duration. teardown.drain replaces the 2022 teardown.sleep(1000).

definition.title: 3.1 As status endpoint, I should respond with Bad request or 422 Unprocessable Entity when the request payload has id with empty string
3.4 As status endpoint, I should return 400 Bad request or 422 Unprocessable entitity when the request payload does not only contain id field and its value
3.5 As a service endpoint, I should respond with 404 Not found when the id does not exist in the database
3.6 As a service endpoint, I should respond with 404 Not found when the id is not valid
definition.notes: Also covers 2022 spec 4.6, its verbatim duplicate — 26 case files cover 27 executable specs.

definition.title: 2.1 As submit endpoint, I should respond with 400 Bad request or 422 Unprocessable Entity when the request payload is missing code field
2.2 As submit endpoint, I should return 400 Bad request or 422 Unprocessable Entity when the request payload does not only contain code field and value
2.4 As submit endpoint, I should respond with 400 Bad request or 422 Unprocessable Entity when the request payload has invalid value type for code field
